summary: Frontend-only static portfolio site tested end-to-end via Playwright against the public preview URL. All 11 requested feature checks pass: hero content and portrait, bilingual ES/EN toggling (navbar + footer buttons) with localStorage persistence (key 'gmp-lang', default 'es'), all 4 project cases render with images, visit/repo links point to correct URLs with target=_blank, CV links resolve to /assets/cv/Gonzalo-Marti-CV-2026.pdf (HTTP 200 verified via curl), hero CTAs scroll to correct anchors, contact links (mailto/GitHub/LinkedIn) correct, footer back-to-top works, no console/page errors, no broken images (naturalWidth>0 for all imgs), mobile viewport 390x844 renders correctly and burger menu opens with all links.
critical_code_review_comments: No issues found. Site is clean, semantic, uses data-testid consistently. Hero role text is rendered lowercase in DOM but displayed uppercase via CSS text-transform, which is the correct approach.
Backend supervisor service is intentionally FATAL (no backend by design) — confirmed with product spec, not an issue.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static Vite/React SPA at https://95a8ca09-1f9b-4f64-a992-f1e0b1768f10.preview.emergentagent.com. No backend. All data-testids exist as documented in the request. Language stored under localStorage 'gmp-lang'. CV PDF at /assets/cv/Gonzalo-Marti-CV-2026.pdf returns 200. Note: hero role/nav labels appear UPPERCASE via CSS; when asserting text with inner_text(), use uppercase or case-insensitive matching (e.g., 'WEB DEVELOPER' / 'DESARROLLADOR WEB').
